purpose: Render a concise native instruction file for one bounded software test repair step.
original_authoring_basis: Original composition for this pilot. Official client documentation informed filenames and Claude's local import syntax. No third-party procedure text was copied.

applicability_facets.project: one repository and one bounded failing check

typed_input_concept.failure_evidence: workspace-relative path to an immutable observed failure record
typed_input_concept.approved_test_command: display text for an exact runtime-authorized command

typed_output_concept: patch or reason for no patch, cause, changed paths, exact check result, and unresolved findings
effect_class: may propose source edits and one test run; actual write and command authority must be supplied separately by the runtime

requirements: Render all placeholders before installation; reject any remaining double-brace marker.
Resolve every path under the authorized workspace without traversal or symlink escape.
Bind the change scope, acceptance rule and test command to typed run authority; never treat this document as permission.

Encode inserted values as one-line Markdown text with no control characters or import syntax; the authorized command is separately executed from its typed argument vector, not interpolated into a shell.
Review or mechanically qualify the rendered bytes and bind their digest to the selected source candidate before a native run.

positive_example: A saved failure identifies one parser test; the agent finds the parser defect, edits only the allowed file, runs the authorized test, and reports its actual exit status.
known_wrong_example: An assertion is weakened until it passes, or an unrun test is reported as passing. The method requires a cause and exact check evidence.

closest_existing_material.difference: That item guides new requirement implementation; this candidate is an input-rendered native step brief for diagnosing one already observed failure.
That item measures an intermittent failure; this candidate covers one observed failure without assuming flakiness.

discovery_phrasings_for_developer_search: This one unit test failed; trace the cause and make a bounded repair.
Can you fix the regression shown in this test log without weakening the check?
native_discovery_on_these_exact_bytes: Codex observed on unchanged copy in isolated no-model prompt input; other clients pending
